results.title: ‘Rahul, Rahul, Rahul’: Janakpur’s 16-year-old pacer is the NPL’s newest sensation
results.content: The talent-hunt find took four wickets against Kathmandu Gorkhas, striking with the first ball of two separate overs, and the stadium has already adopted him.

results.title: Small countries must defend multilateral trade system, says WTO chief
results.content: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala urges developing economies, including Nepal, to push for reforms and use WTO tools to help local businesses access global markets.

results.title: Foreign enrolment remains a hard sell for Nepali medical colleges
results.content: Nepal reserves 33 percent of medical education seats for foreign students, but only 746 enrolled last year.

results.title: Indian foreign secretary, new ambassador to arrive in Kathmandu ahead of Shah’s India visit
results.content: Vikram Misri is scheduled to arrive on November 4 to discuss the agenda for the prime minister’s expected visit to New Delhi, likely on November 22, while Sudhakar Dalela arrives a day earlier to take up his diplomatic assignment.

results.title: Janakpur Bolts beat Kathmandu Gorkhas by eight wickets
results.content: Rahul Yadav takes four wickets to bowl Kathmandu out for 115 before Moeen Ali and Saif Hassan guide Janakpur to victory with an unbeaten stand.

results.title: Cyclone Arnab’s remnants raise landslide risk on Nepal’s main highways
results.content: Authorities have flagged key routes as vulnerable to landslides, rockfalls and flooding as the storm that struck India’s Andhra Pradesh coast weakens and brings rain to Nepal.

results.title: Rain expected across Nepal on Thursday as cyclone weakens
results.content: The system is forecast to bring rain from Thursday afternoon, with heavy downpours possible overnight and on Friday.

results.title: Nepal government’s film grant scheme gets mixed reviews
results.content: The government aims to promote films that highlight the country’s culture, history and tourism. Filmmakers welcome the move but criticise the 21-day deadline.

results.title: Driving licence applicants in Kathmandu face week-long waits for trials
results.content: Server outages and excessive fees have added to applicants’ woes. Legal hurdles have delayed plans for new centres.

results.title: Nepal needs meaningful actions to end child marriage by 2030
results.content: Nepal’s progress remains uneven, with poverty leaving girls in disadvantaged households more vulnerable.

results.title: What a regional climate agreement for the Himalayas should contain
results.content: Prime Minister Shah’s proposed Himalayan Climate Resilience Mechanism is a welcome start. A regional legal agreement among Nepal, India and China would give it a foundation.
